game_title: Door Defense – Ore Vein Depths Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the cave gate while the while-loop condition stays true and shadow wraiths keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Push to repair the cave gate while the while-loop condition stays true and shadow wraiths keep attacking. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the cave miner ahead. Then check the door_health value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the cave gate by solving code steps involving door_health that move the cave miner forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the cave gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Door Defense
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Door Defense' (Week 4 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ore Vein Depths'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
